authority.operational_baseline: MV-IA-F014 Vehicle, Mecha, and Starship Operations
authority.positioning_baseline: MV-IA-F013 Bounded Maps, Zones, and Tactical Positioning
authority.asset_baseline: MV-IA-F008 plus PPIA-03 Items, Equipment & Inventory Experience
authority.structured_content_authority: 8E-009 CSV-first vehicle domain within final 20-dataset / 19,199-row reconciliation

identity_state_layers.name: Definition Variant / Class / Configuration
rules: configuration is not a live owned vehicle
same name or source grouping never creates identity merge

identity_state_layers.name: Component / Module / System Definition
rules: name similarity cannot create parent link
component Definition is distinct from installation state

identity_state_layers.name: Installed Components / Loadout / Hardpoints
rules: installation never silently transfers component ownership
hidden installed systems are permission-filtered before counts

identity_state_layers.name: Scene Deployment / Placement
rules: placement does not duplicate the vehicle Asset
canvas coordinates are presentation unless rules-bound

identity_state_layers.name: Live Session / Encounter Operational State
rules: server-authoritative
client controls/projections do not directly mutate state

identity_state_layers.name: Ownership / Custody / Control / Access
rules: ownership does not imply control
custody does not imply station authority
station assignment does not transfer ownership

identity_state_layers.name: Crew / Passenger / Station Assignments
rules: station authority is explicit
multiple stations only where profile permits
conflicting commands resolve by declared command policy rather than UI order

identity_state_layers.name: Cargo / Containment / Carried or Attached Craft
rules: generic Asset/inventory semantics inherit PPIA-03
hidden cargo/occupants/craft are filtered before totals/counts

identity_state_layers.name: Hull / Frame / Subsystem Damage and Failure
rules: zero hull never universally deletes Asset/history
damage consequences are profile/rule bound

identity_state_layers.name: Power / Fuel / Ammo / Charge / Heat / Stress / Maintenance Resources
rules: unknown/source-unspecified is not zero or unlimited
accepted actions mutate resources atomically with outcomes

identity_state_layers.name: Movement / Position / Environment / Docking State
rules: semantic position is authoritative
visual geometry alone cannot determine rules

identity_state_layers.name: Source / Provenance / History / Recovery
rules: history is role-filtered before aggregation/export
ambiguous network outcomes use status lookup before retry

explicitly_deferred_capabilities: real-time crew station concurrency at scale
source_guardrails: Raw CSV/source provenance and unmapped source fields remain preserved.
No silent defaults are introduced to make a vehicle UI appear complete.
Mecha/spacecraft component parent relationships require explicit evidence; name similarity is insufficient.
Recovered R1 vehicle/system headings remain source-review candidates and cannot create Definitions or mechanics by themselves.
Source fact, source-unspecified value, inference/recommendation, conflict, configuration state, Campaign state and runtime state remain distinguishable.
permission_invariants: authorize before vehicle existence, search, station roster, occupant/cargo counts, system list, resources, routes, capabilities, provenance, history, exports, diagnostics, notifications or AI context
hidden occupants, cargo, systems, carried craft, routes and capabilities cannot leak through totals, capacity summaries, readiness indicators or failed actions
GM authority is Campaign-scoped and does not imply unrelated user-private or other-Campaign access
station controls disappear immediately after authority revocation and protected caches are invalidated
AI/service projections are minimum necessary and cannot independently command, move, attack, route power, reveal, transfer ownership or promote content
mutation_invariants: vehicle Definition inspection never mutates source content
deployment/placement never creates a duplicate owned vehicle Asset
install/uninstall never silently transfers component ownership
accepted movement/actions/damage/resource outcomes are atomic and server-authoritative
commands use idempotency and expected versions
offline authoritative vehicle mutation is prohibited
boundary: This taxonomy is an implementation-ready PPIA-04 foundation. It does not promote CSV/R1 content, invent source facts, implement application runtime, activate A2, or authorize release/deployment.
